assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
CPT 93229 is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring

The clinical indication note documents a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation
The submitted diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I47.1

The note states that given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management
The denial is based on an authorization-based denial
